name: Number One
tagline: Front desk for your coverage bot fleet: routes each job and keeps approvals in one queue.
description: This is the desk you actually talk to when a fleet of coverage bots does the work behind it. You bring a task, it works out which specialist owns it, hands the job over and tracks it through to handoff. Anything that would reach a customer or a carrier waits in an approval queue - nothing moves until you have nodded.
author: ladybarrelmaker
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
